transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net full fibre infrastructure support, my name is Rachel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Rachel, my name is Patrick O'Connor. A delivery van backed into our front driveway brick pillar this morning and sheared the plastic external Customer Splice Point box off our exterior wall, leaving the optical fiber cable dangling in mid-air with the glass core severed!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Patrick. If I understand correctly, an external vehicle impact has ripped the Customer Splice Point box off your exterior wall and severed the incoming optical fiber cable, knocking your full fibre broadband offline. Before we inspect your infrastructure line record, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 12 Mill Lane, Harrogate, HG1 5AA, security PIN 3314, customer reference BB-884192.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Patrick, that confirms your account details. Are there any live exposed electrical cables or hazards near the broken fiber wall box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No electrical lines, only the yellow plastic optical fiber cable hanging loose by the driveway pillar.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the Openreach emergency civil engineering gateway for North Yorkshire?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Patrick. The optical line telemetry confirms a complete optical loss of signal with light levels dropping to minus infinity decibels.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can an engineer replace the external wall box and re-splice the fiber today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, physical severance of external customer premises optical wiring is categorized as an emergency external infrastructure repair.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will there be any callout or repair charges for fixing the wall box?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, because the damage occurred on the external property boundary prior to the internal demarcation point, external infrastructure repairs are carried out free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is fantastic news; I was worried S-Net would charge us for a third-party van driver's mistake.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We can also log the third-party delivery vehicle registration number if our legal recovery team needs to reclaim costs from their commercial motor insurer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I photographed the van license plate and delivery company logo.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have uploaded the delivery vehicle details to our corporate insurance recovery queue.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When is the earliest Openreach fiber engineer available to attend?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because this involves severed external cabling across a residential driveway, I am scheduling an emergency priority dispatch for this afternoon between one and five o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This afternoon?! That is phenomenal speed of response!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously optical fiber strands require fusion splicing in a clean enclosure to achieve low decibel insertion loss.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right, I know fiber glass strands cannot just be twisted back together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Patrick speaking, I run a bespoke architectural practice from my home studio, and I have fifty gigabytes of CAD blueprint models that must be submitted to the planning commission by six o'clock tonight! If our internet is down and I miss the planning deadline, my clients will cancel a seventy-thousand-pound renovation and my practice will face financial ruin! I am sweating and in sheer panic!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the sheer panic and intense pressure this has put on your architectural practice, Patrick, especially with a critical planning commission deadline at six o'clock tonight. Facing the loss of a major client over an accidental cable cut is terrifying, and I will ensure the emergency technician is dispatched and provide immediate mobile backup data right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What mobile backup data can you provide?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added an unlimited emergency mobile data tethering bolt-on to your S-Net mobile plan with immediate activation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking my mobile phone... SMS received: 'Unlimited Emergency Broadband Backup Data activated'!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can turn on Personal Hotspot on your mobile phone right now to upload your CAD blueprint files while the fiber is repaired.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Connecting my studio workstation to my phone hotspot... The fifty gigabytes of blueprints are uploading right now at sixty megabits per second!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That guarantees your planning commission submission will be delivered well before the six o'clock deadline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have completely saved my architectural firm from disaster today, Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Openreach optical engineering crew has been dispatched under priority job reference OPT-EMERG-44910.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: OPT-EMERG-44910, noted in my work logbook.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The technician will arrive with a new weather-sealed Customer Splice Point enclosure and a precision core alignment fusion splicer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will they need access inside our house, or only the outside driveway pillar?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: They will mount the new box outside, perform the fusion splice, and only enter briefly to verify optical light levels on your internal ONT.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will be working in the studio all afternoon, so I will let them straight in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have sent an SMS tracking link that displays the engineer's live van transit coordinates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening tracking link... The van is fifteen minutes away in central Harrogate!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Everything is proceeding with maximum urgency.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your emergency response has been world-class from start to finish.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Patrick, our priority is always protecting our customers' connectivity during unexpected incidents.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can breathe a huge sigh of relief now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just making sure the engineer attends the exact premises: that was 12 Mill Lane, wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 12 Mill Lane, Harrogate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Patrick, all technician coordinates and mobile backup records are fully synchronized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Rachel for your swift, compassionate, and brilliant assistance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been an absolute pleasure helping you, Patrick. Best of luck with your planning submission.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have a wonderful afternoon, Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your full fibre service I can assist you with today, Patrick?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Rachel, everything is completely taken care of.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net full fibre infrastructure support, Patrick. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Rachel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
